caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with chashu, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake, artfully arranged in a white bowl. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table, with a glass and bottle softly blurred in the background.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with a pale pink interior, browned edges, and sesame seeds on its surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, sliced pieces with a glossy surface and faint fibrous texture.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl center, pale yellow outer layer, scalloped edge, smooth surface with slight sheen.
